title: Wgpu Floating Window Rails Parity Fix
description: Restore real frosted-glass panels in the wgpu renderer (side panel, context menus/dropdowns, window measures/engagement rails) via GPU backdrop-blur + saturate + tint composite.
summary:
Fixed wgpu window measures (Window Options) and engagement (Command) rails to match pre-migration React floating overlay behavior.

Root cause: rails shrank the window content rect before drawing body content, acting as docked sidebars instead of absolute overlays.

Changes:
- Reordered dock window render: content first, then measures/engagement overlays (hit-test priority matches React DOM order)
- Removed content rect mutation; rails float with gap_standard inset
- Token-derived widths on Theme (window_measures_default_width 224px, window_engagement_max_width 448px); measures resize uses panel_min/max_width
- Auto-height glass cards from measure/engagement body height helpers (capped by window body)
- Fixed measures tree sibling y-stacking bug; engagement control y advance
- Added window_rail_widths_match_react_dom_tokens test

cargo check -p semio-framework-renderer-wgpu passed.
